this_title: The Comic Strip Presents: Red Nose of Courage
introduction: Adrian Edmondson plays a clown who is not happy with his job at his father's circus, so he gets into politics, and some weeks later he is the Prime Minister John Major. But after his day job, he has to attend to his real job as Bozo the Clown. He falls in love with the leader of the opposition party, but she falls in love with Bozo the Clown without knowing that he is in fact John Major, the Prime Minister. Written by Sand of Norway
